image_description: A crowded aquarium scene featuring multiple fish species. The primary subject in the foreground is a large, laterally compressed angelfish with a vibrant blue body and yellow tail (likely a Queen Angelfish). Behind it, partially obscured, is another fish exhibiting the black anterior and yellow posterior coloration characteristic of a Rock Beauty. Other smaller, silver/white fish are visible in the background near wooden structures.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fish located behind the blue angelfish clearly displays the diagnostic black head/thorax and yellow abdomen/tail pattern. However, it is partially occluded by the foreground subject.

The anal fin of the target Rock Beauty is obscured by the body of the foreground blue fish.
The caudal fin of the background Rock Beauty is visible and appears rounded, matching the species description.
